sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Yes/no questions can use the same basic word order with question intonation. Question words such as ki, mi, *hol*, mit and miért introduce information questions.

miért literally breaks down as mi (‘what’) + ért (‘for / because of’) — so word-for-word, ‘why’ in Hungarian is asking ‘for what.’ Spotting these built-from-parts words is a great habit: it turns rote memorization into small, logical puzzles.
